meta.purpose: Semantic-to-wire cross-reference table: for each semantic, how it is expressed on each of the three wires (Responses / Chat Completions / Anthropic Messages). Fixture names resolve relative to this directory. Vocabulary per CONTEXT.md (ticket 06); wire constants and usage_metadata rulings per ADR-0002; per-wire module shapes per core/src/client/wire/{chat,anthropic}.rs and codex-api/src/sse/{responses,chat_completions,messages}.rs.
meta.verified_against: fork merge base ed4bb72516f + second-round lanes + ticket 10/11 wire changes
meta.maintenance: On every upstream merge, re-verify rows whose wire domain was touched and bump verified_date. Flip the degraded chat thinking row to native when ticket 10 lands, and record reasoning_effort translation when ticket 11 lands. A stale table is the frozen-fixture antipattern (reports/09-wire-mock-cross-fixture-research-index.md).

support_legend.native: the upstream protocol expresses the semantic natively; the fork passes it through
support_legend.translated: the fork synthesizes the semantic on this wire from the shared ResponseItem IR
support_legend.degraded: the fork drops or downgrades the semantic on this wire (fail-loud or silent-drop recorded here)
support_legend.absent: the wire has no equivalent; the fork neither sends nor accepts it

replay_constraints: output_item.done function_call item is authoritative; arguments delta fragments are not consumed verbatim
consecutive tool calls MUST coalesce into one assistant tool_calls array (strict servers 400 otherwise)
tool output replays as {role:"tool", tool_call_id, content}
no-argument tool_use serializes input:{} not null (400 otherwise)
tool results travel as tool_result blocks under a user message; strict user/assistant alternation
reasoning request controls (reasoning.effort/summary) are native on Responses; chat/anthropic request controls are translated per their wire mappings
reasoning_content is synthesized into ResponseItem::Reasoning and replayed as assistant reasoning_content
reasoning_effort is translated on the request side
PERMANENT RED LINE: thinking blocks replay verbatim (text AND signature) inside tool-use rounds; server 400s the whole turn otherwise
a reasoning item WITHOUT a signature is dropped, never rewritten
never merge thinking content into text content blocks
request side: provider.anthropic_thinking_budget -> thinking:{type:"enabled",budget_tokens} clamped to [1024, max_tokens-1]
